title: 練習本 A｜精選文法題

questions.question: Fanny: ______ is the last baseball game this year? Ken: On Saturday. It's also my birthday!
questions.explanation: 回答 Saturday 是「星期幾」，所以用 What day。

questions.question: Jam, ______ so hard on yourself. Take it easy. We know you didn't mean to.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句結構為 Don't + 原形 be 動詞 + 形容詞。

questions.question: Brian's brother is not home now. He ______ his friends in the USA.
questions.explanation: now 表示現在進行式 (be + V-ing)。

questions.question: I don't like the pictures on these T-shirts. However, I like that one over there. Can I take a look at ______, please?
questions.explanation: that one 是單數，受詞代名詞用 it。

questions.question: ______ a new breakfast shop on Gina's way to work. It is really convenient for her, and she is happy about it.
questions.explanation: 表示「某地有某物」用 There is/are。

questions.question: Ivy: ______ is Nancy? I last saw her two months ago. Tim: She's fine. She went to the UK last month, and now she is studying at a language school there.
questions.explanation: 問近況用 How is + 人。

questions.question: Can you get me ______ pink marker in the drawer? There is only one there. I need it to paint the girl's hair in my picture.
questions.explanation: 抽屜裡只有「那一支」特定的粉紅色筆，用定冠詞 the。

questions.question: Lisa has two hamburgers every meal, ______ she doesn't get heavy at all. How is it possible?
questions.explanation: 吃很多卻沒變胖，前後語意對比，用 but。

questions.question: Oh, no! My bun is like a round piece of paper now! Dad didn't notice it, and he put a heavy box ______ it.
questions.explanation: 重盒子壓「在」麵包上，所以用 on。

questions.question: I ______ go to school without eating breakfast. It's very important to have a good meal at the start of a day.
questions.explanation: 因為早餐很重要，所以「從不」不吃就上學。

questions.question: Eric went swimming every morning last year, but he ______ now.
questions.explanation: 對應主動詞 went swimming，現在的否定用 doesn't。

questions.question: Peter didn't pass the driving test ______ he went to the wrong place. In fact, he didn't even have a chance to take it.
questions.explanation: 表示原因，用 because。

questions.question: I just bought a strawberry cake. Let's enjoy it. Oh, my! My dog ______ it now. Stop eating, Kenny!
questions.explanation: now 表示現在進行式。

questions.question: Jane: I didn't see Judy at John's party last night. ______ she sick? Meg: Yes. She had a serious cold and couldn't join the party.
questions.explanation: last night 為過去式，主詞 she 用 was。

questions.question: Jason was late for the show, so there was no seat for him. He could only ______ the room.
questions.explanation: 沒位子只能站「在房間後方」。

questions.question: Ben said he would study Japanese for one hour every day, ______ he really kept his words. Now he speaks like a Japanese.
questions.explanation: 說到做到，前後語意一致，用 and。

questions.question: The sheep are cute and friendly. Let's go get some grass to feed ______.
questions.explanation: sheep 此處為複數，受詞代名詞用 them。

questions.question: (Ann and Tanya are at an expensive restaurant with their boss.) Ann: Don't worry about the money. Our boss will get the check for this meal tonight. Tanya: That's great. Then I can eat a lot. What does get the check mean?
questions.explanation: get the check 為「結帳、付帳」之意。

questions.question: Dad: What's your birthday wish? Annie: I would really love a new bicycle. Dad: No problem. I'll buy ______ for you.
questions.explanation: 泛指「一台新腳踏車」，未指特定一台，用 one。

questions.question: Mina: Oh, no! My computer doesn't work! What can I do? Sean: Don't worry. I ______ fix it. Let me check.
questions.explanation: 表示「我會修、我能修」的能力。

questions.question: Mom: Ben, I am going to have a business meeting in my office tonight. Ben: No worries, Mom. Dad will be home and help me to ______ dinner in the kitchen. Take care of yourself.
questions.explanation: 「在廚房做晚餐」固定用 make dinner。

questions.question: Grandpa can't read the newspaper because it is right ______ Judy's body. Judy, our lovely cat, finds it comfortable as a bed and doesn't want to move away at all.
questions.explanation: 貓壓在報紙上，所以報紙在貓「身體下方」。

questions.question: Ryan's mom got very sick two months ago. He ______ a better doctor to treat her. Do you know any good one?
questions.explanation: 他現在仍持續在找醫生，用現在進行式。

questions.question: Clerk: Welcome to Happy Mart. Spend NT$100, and you can get one Happy point. Ben: I see. Can you check my Happy points? ______ do I have now? Clerk: No problem. First, please download our app, Happy Mart, and then I will show you your points.
questions.explanation: points 為可數複數，用 How many。

questions.question: ______ a coffee shop near the park. Students often go there, order one drink and study there all day long.
questions.explanation: 「公園附近有一家咖啡店」用 There is。

questions.question: Lisa: Can I take ______? I really like the color. Helen: Go ahead. They are right in front of you.
questions.explanation: They 為複數，且 in front of you 為近距離，用 these。

questions.question: Collecting dolls ______ my sister's hobby when she was a little girl. Now she collects toy cars, trucks, and planes.
questions.explanation: 動名詞主詞視為單數；when she was a little girl 表過去。

questions.question: Wow! Zeo is like a queen. I don't know she ______ dance so well. I thought there were only books in her life.
questions.explanation: 表示「會跳舞」這項能力。

questions.question: You won't know how it will turn out until the very end. So, ______ on watching.
questions.explanation: 祈使句用原形動詞 keep on V-ing。

questions.question: You better save money for a rainy day, my friend! Don't ______ count on your parents. They will get old some day.
questions.explanation: 「不要老是依賴父母」，Don't always 為常見搭配。

questions.question: Tina: Where were you last night? I couldn't reach you. Sandy: Sorry, I ______ a hot spring bath when you called.
questions.explanation: when you called 為過去某時，正在洗澡用過去進行式。

questions.question: My cat likes to sleep ______ the blanket. You can't see him at the first sight, but you will find the blanket is in the shape of a cat if you look carefully.
questions.explanation: 「在毯子下睡覺」所以看不到，用 under。

questions.question: ChatGPT can answer most of our questions clearly, ______ some students use it in a wrong way like copying the answers from ChatGPT for their homework.
questions.explanation: 好處 vs. 誤用，前後對比用 but。

questions.question: After lending NT$10,000 to his brother, Mark didn't have much money to ______ on his meals this month.
questions.explanation: spend money on something 是固定搭配。

questions.question: It rained a lot here in summer before, but ______ this year. So there's not enough fresh water for us.
questions.explanation: 對比 before（過去多雨）vs. this year（今年少雨），且後句說缺水，故今年雨少。

questions.question: Sir, your car is in my way. I cannot drive ______ out of the drive. Could you please move your car a few feet?
questions.explanation: mine = my car，作 drive 的受詞。

questions.question: Yesterday Wendy told me that she is going on a trip with her family this weekend. So Jane and I ______ hiking without her.
questions.explanation: this weekend 為未來，主詞為複數 Jane and I，用 will go。

questions.question: Johnny: Mommy, would you get me a piece of pizza from the kitchen? I'm still hungry. Mom: ______ one? You ate four just now. I think that's enough.
questions.explanation: 「再來一片？」用 Another (= one more)。

questions.question: It took John and his brother around three days ______ the kite. Seeing it flying in the sky filled them with joy.
questions.explanation: It takes + 時間 + to + 原形動詞。

questions.question: The water level of the river is far lower than it was last year. That's ______ there is very little rain this year.
questions.explanation: That's because + 原因子句。

questions.question: ______ a better cook, the woman goes to class and reads cookbooks.
questions.explanation: 「為了成為更好的廚師」表目的，用 to + 原形。

questions.question: Bill: Excuse me. ______ do I get to The Rainbow Music Center? Ted: You can take Bus 105 or 609, but the music center is not open today.
questions.explanation: 問「怎麼到達」一個地方，用 How。

questions.question: Willy: Where is the salt? Mia: There it is, ______ above your head. Raise your hand, and you can reach it.
questions.explanation: right above 「就在……的正上方」。

questions.question: May: Why do you go to work ______ the bike every day? It's a long way to ride. Ben: Yes, it takes about 30 minutes. And I do it for my health.
questions.explanation: on the bike（特定那台腳踏車）；by bike 不加 the。

questions.question: Turn around and take a look, Sam. There's a cute cat ______ you.
questions.explanation: 要他轉身才看得到，貓在他「後面」。

questions.question: Linda lives with her family in a small apartment. They ______ to their new apartment in two weeks.
questions.explanation: 表示已安排好的近未來，用現在進行式。

questions.question: Life in this town was not easy. People had to spend hours going to the city to shop for food. Luckily, ______ finally a supermarket in town.
questions.explanation: 現在「終於有」一家超市，用 there is。

questions.question: Helen knows a lot about the art museums in Italy because she ______ there for eight years. She came back to Taiwan in 2022.
questions.explanation: 2022 已回台灣，過去八年的事用過去簡單式。

questions.question: Jimmy has a serious sore throat, ______ his mom won't prepare anything too hot or too cold for him.
questions.explanation: 因為喉嚨痛，「所以」媽媽不準備太冷太熱。

questions.question: Dad: Our son ______ all the weekend studying English and math. Mom: He always does this only when big tests are around the corner.
questions.explanation: spend + 時間 + V-ing 為固定句型。

questions.question: ______ hard day after day, David is getting better at playing tennis little by little.
questions.explanation: 表示「藉由……」的方法，用 By + V-ing。

questions.question: Don't ask me anything about cooking. I have ______ knowledge of it.
questions.explanation: knowledge 為不可數，且語意為「幾乎沒有」，用 little。

questions.question: Jane: Hey, did you hear what Dad just said? Gil: No. I ______ with my friend on the phone then.
questions.explanation: 那時正在講電話沒聽到，用過去進行式。

questions.question: Those basketball players practiced hard before the game, so it was surprising for them ______ the game.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + for sb. + to V 句型。

questions.question: Jim: Can I drive your car to get some drinks and snacks, please? Howard: No way! I don't want ______ to get dirty. You always leave trash in the car.
questions.explanation: 指特定那台車，用 it。

questions.question: Yesterday when Johnny was walking on the street, he noticed someone following him and ______ pictures of him.
questions.explanation: notice + sb + V-ing；和 following 平行結構。

questions.question: The chocolate cake you made yesterday tasted so ______. Could you teach me how to make it?
questions.explanation: 感官動詞 taste + 形容詞。

questions.question: Kids, please don't run around and be quiet. Everyone has a chance to play on the swing, but you have to ______. Now please line up, and each will have five minutes.
questions.explanation: 「輪流」玩鞦韆，用 take turns。

questions.question: Eason: Where is Dad? I want to buy a pencil box, but I don't have enough money. Wendy: Then you'll have to wait. He ______ in his bedroom right now.
questions.explanation: right now 表示現在進行式。

questions.question: If you don't have time for dinner today, ______ free to call me. Maybe we can just meet at the coffee shop near my office this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 祈使句 Feel free to + 原形。

questions.question: You need to listen carefully to your teacher in class and study hard after school. After all, getting good grades on tests is never easy, ______?
questions.explanation: 原句含 never（否定），附加問句用肯定 is it；主詞 getting good grades = it。

questions.question: Kelly is the ______ of the two girls in her family. She was born two minutes later than her sister.
questions.explanation: 兩人比較用比較級，且晚出生表示「較年輕」。

questions.question: Tina: Would you like some more fish or soup? Sam: Sure, but I'm ______ full. Please just give me a small piece of fish. No soup, thank you.
questions.explanation: 「快要飽了」用 almost full。

questions.question: I don't think Mom will allow us to join the party if we ______ our bedroom on Friday.
questions.explanation: if 條件句中表未來時，主句用未來、從句用現在簡單式。

questions.question: Of all my teachers, I like Ms. Lee ______ because she never gets angry every time I forget to hand in my homework.
questions.explanation: 在所有老師中「最」喜歡她，用最高級 the most。

questions.question: Johnny didn't stop crying ______ his dad bought him the toy plane.
questions.explanation: 「直到」爸爸買玩具給他才停止哭。

questions.question: Tina: ______ I feel tired, I usually lie lazily on the sofa for a rest. After that, I can get ready to do other things. June: Me, too. Sometimes I also listen to light music.
questions.explanation: 「當我累的時候」會做某事，用 When。

questions.question: I didn't check the news ______ I went out, so I didn't know my train to Taipei stopped until I got to the station.
questions.explanation: 「出門之前」沒看新聞。

questions.question: Every time Lisa's father asks her to go fishing with him, she ______ says she has to work. She is not interested in it at all.
questions.explanation: 每次都拿工作當藉口，用 always。

questions.question: Teresa only eats fruit and vegetables for meals. She wants to lose 5 kg and become as thin as she ______.
questions.explanation: 想恢復成「以前那麼瘦」，用過去式 was。
questions.note: 此題稍微模稜兩可，請再次確認

questions.question: Mrs. Wang couldn't bear to see her grandson cry, so she ______ him eat some ice cream without telling the boy's mother.
questions.explanation: let + sb + 原形動詞，「讓他吃」。

questions.question: The store on the corner is having a sale. Everything there ______ less. You can go and take a look if you need anything.
questions.explanation: 物品為主詞，用 cost；Everything 視為單數。

questions.question: Although the jacket ______ is cheap and comfortable, I don't like the color of it.
questions.explanation: itself 強調「外套本身」便宜舒適，但不喜歡顏色。

questions.question: Of all the students, Larry deals with things ______, so we choose him to be our class leader. And he does a pretty good job.
questions.explanation: Of all the students 表「在所有人中」最高級，副詞用 most carefully。

questions.question: Mrs. Yang is unhappy that her son didn't clean his room this morning. She ______ him to finish doing it in one hour, or he can't go to the movies.
questions.explanation: tell sb to V 為固定句型。

questions.question: Mark wants to visit his aunt in America next month, but his wife ______ with him. She has a lot of work to do.
questions.explanation: next month 為未來，否定用 won't go。

questions.question: Kevin is not sure if it will snow tomorrow, but if it ______, he will take the train to work.
questions.explanation: 用 does 代替 snows，避免重複動詞。

questions.question: To make sure that she makes no mistakes this time, Mia is checking her report ______ than she usually does.
questions.explanation: than 為比較級，副詞 more carefully 修飾 is checking。

questions.question: Could you please hold on for a few ______? I'll bring the phone to Dr. Johnson right away.
questions.explanation: 「請稍等幾秒」用 seconds 最合理。

questions.question: I saw the famous singer ______ when I went to the department store last night. He looked very cool.
questions.explanation: He 為男性，反身代名詞用 himself 強調「歌手本人」。

questions.question: Amy: Did you see Tom wearing a new pair of shoes today? Sue: Really? I ______ hello to him just now, but I didn't notice it.
questions.explanation: 在打招呼的當下沒注意到鞋子，動作正在進行，用過去進行式。

questions.question: My parents ______ me get up early and go jogging at the park because they wanted me to keep healthy.
questions.explanation: make + sb + 原形動詞；其餘選項需 to。

questions.question: The prices of the houses with two or three bedrooms in this area are getting too high for young people. ______ of them are able to buy one.
questions.explanation: 價格太高，「很少人」買得起；them 指人，用 Few。

questions.question: Because lots of chickens died, now the price of eggs is getting ______. Even so, people still line up to get some.
questions.explanation: 「越來越高」用 比較級 + and + 比較級。

questions.question: Mrs. Lee: Where ______ the child's parents when the policemen came? Mr. Lee: I don't know. The newspaper didn't say anything about that.
questions.explanation: parents 為複數、過去式，用 were。

questions.question: Amy: Jimmy, you know a lot about movies. How often do you watch movies? Jimmy: ______! Watching movies is my favorite. A movie a day keeps bad things away!
questions.explanation: 每天看電影、是最愛，頻率用 Always。

questions.question: Your idea sounds ______. I think you will make it come true.
questions.explanation: sound + 形容詞；lovely 雖以 -ly 結尾仍為形容詞，且語意正面。

questions.question: There are too many people at the festival. To keep the kids safe, we have to keep a ______ eye on people around them.
questions.explanation: keep a sharp eye on「警覺地盯著」是固定用法。

questions.question: Jack: Hello? Ivy: Jack, this is Ivy. What can I do? A bird ______ around in my house now! Jack: Don't worry. I'm coming to help you.
questions.explanation: now 表示現在進行式。

questions.question: Because Susan is an early bird, she thinks ______ is no trouble at all to get up early for her new job.
questions.explanation: it 作虛主詞，真正主詞是後面的 to V。

questions.question: I'm not sure when my boss will come to the office today. If he ______, I'll call you right away.
questions.explanation: 以 does 代替前句的 comes，用於 if 條件子句。

questions.question: Joe worked for over ten hours every day last month. It almost ______ him his life. He won't work long hours any more.
questions.explanation: cost sb sth「使某人付出（生命、代價）」。

questions.question: ______ better grades, some students cheated by sharing the answers with each other.
questions.explanation: 表目的「為了拿到較好成績」，用 to + 原形。

questions.question: No one knows ______ Jack left the office. But Ivy said she last saw him at the office at a quarter to four.
questions.explanation: 3:45 為時間，所以問「何時」離開。

questions.question: Nancy: How was your trip to Poland? Tina: Well, the food was good, but it was over 40°C, too hot! We ______ stay inside most of the time.
questions.explanation: 過去因太熱「不得不」待室內，用 had to。

questions.question: Cindy: Good evening, Mr. White. Today we have tomato soup and pumpkin soup. ______ would you like? Mr. White: I don't need soup today. Please give me cold milk tea.
questions.explanation: 在兩種湯中「選一個」，用 Which。

questions.question: The little girl is too young to take care of ______. Her parents should keep an eye on her.
questions.explanation: 照顧自己用反身代名詞 herself。

questions.question: Only the first fifty people who buy the book online will ______ to Mr. Thomas White's birthday party on January 25. Let's hurry.
questions.explanation: 人「被邀請」用被動 be invited。

questions.question: Did Jerry ______ you anything for looking after his cat when he took a trip to London last month? Just saying "thank you" is not enough.
questions.explanation: pay sb sth for...「為某事付錢給某人」。

questions.question: The YouTuber, who ______ to many countries many times this year, is making his latest plan to enjoy another trip in October.
questions.explanation: has been to「曾去過」表經驗；has gone to 表「人已去（不在這裡）」。

questions.question: The dress looks good on you, ______ its price is good. You should buy it.
questions.explanation: 兩個優點並列，用 and。

questions.question: Of all the clothes in the store, the price of the white dress is ______.
questions.explanation: 主詞為 price，與之搭配為 high/low；the highest 為最高級。

questions.question: Ben: Mom, can I buy the shoes? Mrs. Wang: I don't think so. Ben: Please! I will be the coolest guy in my class if I ______ them!
questions.explanation: if 表未來條件時，從句用現在簡單式。

questions.question: What happened? This is not how you ______. I never thought you would try that.
questions.explanation: 「過去本來不是這樣」，用 used to be。

questions.question: My grandpa thinks one is never ______ to learn. He is taking classes to learn how to use the computer, like using Facebook or Instagram.
questions.explanation: never too...to V「永遠不會太……以致於不能」。

questions.question: Kelly ______ shops for clothes on the Net. It is not possible for her to buy any clothes without trying them on first.
questions.explanation: 必須先試穿，所以「從不」網購衣服。

questions.question: This puppy was named Jackie before, but it ______ Marco since my mom took it home from the animal center a few weeks ago.
questions.explanation: since + 過去時間，主句用現在完成式；且為被動「被叫做 Marco」。

questions.question: Ben felt sorry for ______ he did. He lied to his parents about his grades on the tests last week.
questions.explanation: what = the thing(s) that，作介系詞 for 的受詞。

questions.question: Mr. Wu put his bowl and chopsticks down on the table, and so ______ his wife and children.
questions.explanation: so + 助動詞 + 主詞「也是如此」；前句 put 為過去式，故用 did。

questions.question: Bringing up the two children has ______ the woman most of her time. The two children are the ones she cares about the most.
questions.explanation: It takes sb time / sth takes sb time「花費某人時間」。

questions.question: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" is a famous song ______ was written by Mariah Carey and Walter Afanasieff. It is often played every year at Christmas.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 song 為物，關代用 which / that。

questions.question: The singer's voice was really beautiful. His fans listened carefully and stayed there with him ______ the light was off.
questions.explanation: 歌迷待到「直到」燈熄為止。

questions.question: Jessica seldom took a day off from work. That only happened ______ times when she had to take care of her mother in the hospital.
questions.explanation: 呼應 seldom，強調「次數很少」。
questions.note: 嚴格而言英文較常說 a few times；這題在四個選項中以 few 最貼合語意

questions.question: She's had enough on her plate. Don't make it ______ for her. Give her a break, will you?
questions.explanation: 她已忙不過來，別讓事情「更難」。

questions.question: Julie ______ sleeps until noon, and she never has breakfast on weekends. What a terrible habit!
questions.explanation: 與 never 對稱、且呼應 terrible habit。
questions.note: (B) often 在語意上也通，但 always 與後句「絕對化」更呼應

questions.question: ______ Tom ______ his brother loves camping. They are not afraid of the insects outside at all.
questions.explanation: 動詞 loves 為單數，與離它最近的主詞 brother 一致；後句 They 也支持「兩人都喜歡」之意。

questions.question: Yesterday afternoon, when I got home from the library, my aunt ______ the movie theater. She asked me if I wanted to go with her, and I said yes.
questions.explanation: when I got home 為過去某時，姑姑「正要出門」，用過去進行式。

questions.question: Willy: Do you know who the boy ______ a yellow T-shirt is? David: Which one? There are two boys wearing yellow T-shirts.
questions.explanation: 「穿著……衣物」用 in + 衣物。

questions.question: Those letters that are marked in red ______ so far because they are from our important helpers.
questions.explanation: so far 表現在完成式；信被人回，用被動 have been answered。

questions.question: Can you help me with these heavy boxes? ______ full of old books.
questions.explanation: They 指 boxes；be full of「裝滿」。

questions.question: I couldn't believe the handsome boy is Antony! He ______ small and thin.
questions.explanation: 對比現在帥氣與過去瘦小，「過去曾是」用 used to be。

questions.question: The big problem ______ to Tim has made him worried. He really needs help now.
questions.explanation: 用過去式關係子句修飾 problem；事情已發生才造成現在擔憂。

questions.question: Ted: My sister loves swimming and surfing, but I've never been interested in water sports. Sam: ______. I like watching a ball game more.
questions.explanation: 對應前句 have never been；否定附和用「I haven't, either」。

questions.question: The apple pie was so delicious. I just couldn't stop ______ it.
questions.explanation: stop + V-ing「停止做某事」。

questions.question: You usually take a bath when you are tired after work, ______?
questions.explanation: 肯定句的附加問句用否定，主動詞為 take，故用 don't you。

questions.question: Many students were talking loudly, so Mrs. Yao had to ______ her voice to make herself heard.
questions.explanation: raise 為及物動詞「提高（聲音）」，後接受詞 her voice。

questions.question: Sandy ______ a shower when her phone rang, so she couldn't answer it.
questions.explanation: when her phone rang 為過去某時，正在洗澡用過去進行式。

questions.question: Jane made a shopping list last night, but she can't find it now. So she ______ a new one later.
questions.explanation: later 表未來，且為「打算」要做，用 be going to。

questions.question: Mr. Wang has worked very hard since he became a teacher in 2013. He always thinks of fun ways to make his students ______ in English.
questions.explanation: 人對某事感興趣用 interested in。

questions.question: Henry: May I use one of these two pens? Linda: Sure. But this one is broken. Use ______.
questions.explanation: 兩支中的「另一支」（特定）用 the other。

questions.question: Because it has rained heavily since last night, the soccer game ______ today.
questions.explanation: 因下大雨，今天「不會舉行」，被動未來否定。

questions.question: Painting the walls might be tiring, but seeing the beautiful walls ______ me forget about the hard work.
questions.explanation: 動名詞 seeing 作主詞視為單數，用 makes。

questions.question: Both Kevin and Nancy are sitting next to me. I am sitting ______ them.
questions.explanation: 兩人之「間」用 between。

questions.question: The restaurant is popular with kids because there is an area ______ kids can play with toys, dolls and balls.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為地方 area，後接完整子句，關係副詞用 where。

questions.question: When the old man watched the young kids flying kites and ______ everywhere at the park, he felt happy and wore a smile on his face.
questions.explanation: 與 flying 平行的 V-ing 結構，watch + sb + V-ing。

questions.question: Peppa: Do you know ______ you shouldn't take away other people's toys without asking them first? George: Yes. I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
questions.explanation: George 答 Yes 並承認錯誤，故為陳述事實的 that 子句。

questions.question: The boys were so hungry after playing basketball. So there was only ______ food left on the table after lunch.
questions.explanation: food 為不可數，且「幾乎沒剩」，用 little。

questions.question: Daniel: It is raining hard. ______ do you get home? Kelly: My dad is on the way to pick me up. Maybe he can give you a ride. Daniel: That's great.
questions.explanation: 問「怎麼回家」（交通方式），用 How。

questions.question: Kelly's brother read a ghost storybook, and ______. After that, they couldn't sleep alone at night, so they decided not to do it anymore.
questions.explanation: 肯定附和過去式：so + did + 主詞。

questions.question: Mom: It's 12:30. You should go to bed right now, Fred. Fred: I know. But I ______ my math homework. Can you help me with it?
questions.explanation: 「到目前為止還沒寫完」用現在完成式。

questions.question: Honey, look at this picture. This is the house ______ "Little Tree." It's one of the best 100 houses of 2024 around the world.
questions.explanation: 被「稱為 Little Tree」用被動，且 which 引導關係子句修飾 house。

questions.question: Do you know ______? She was here five minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 間接問句用直述語序；She 指 Lisa，故問「Lisa 去哪了」。

questions.question: I've never thought that ______ can help our health as much as running until Judy shared her experience about getting thin by doing that for an hour a day.
questions.explanation: 動名詞作主詞，與 running 比較。

questions.question: Ava has two hobbies. She likes not only going hiking in the mountains ______ some plants on the balcony in her free time.
questions.explanation: not only V-ing but (also) V-ing；四個選項中只有 (A) 維持 V-ing 平行結構。
questions.note: 標準說法應為 but also growing，但是also可省略

questions.question: I think the food in the blue pot might taste ______. Those kids liked both the dishes, but they finished all the food in the blue pot but left some in the white one.
questions.explanation: 兩鍋比較，藍鍋的食物「比較好吃」，用比較級 better。

questions.question: Sam: Where can I put the trash? Ken: It ______ by Joe, but today you'll have to take it out by yourself.
questions.explanation: 表「過去習慣由 Joe 收」，用 used to + 被動。

questions.question: Grandpa is seriously sick. ______ a good boy, and don't let him worry about you, OK?
questions.explanation: 祈使句用原形動詞 Be。

questions.question: Jeff knows the way to the museum. He can tell the driver ______ he should turn left or right even without the map.
questions.explanation: 「左轉或右轉」為二擇一，用 whether...or...。

questions.question: There is always a big sale at ABC Supermarket on the eighth, the eighteenth, and the twenty-eighth of a month. I have just missed ______ and I have to wait for ten more days.
questions.explanation: 三次特賣中「其中一次」用 one。

questions.question: Tom ______ the oldest castle in England when he takes a trip there next month.
questions.explanation: next month 為未來，用 will。

questions.question: Ian: ______ can you do this to me? I gave you all my heart! Wendy: Sorry, but I fall in love with someone else. Let's just be friends.
questions.explanation: 表震驚情緒「你怎麼能這樣對我？」用 How。

questions.question: Jason loves watching movies. He just watched a movie ______ and he is going to watch it again. How come he can watch the same one twice in a day?
questions.explanation: 呼應 twice in a day，剛剛兩小時前看過。

questions.question: The small trees ______ in the yard three years ago were almost as tall as the house.
questions.explanation: 省略關代 that 的關係子句修飾 trees；plant 為過去式 planted。

questions.question: We're ______ with the hardest part of the work already, and the rest will be a lot easier. So, don't give up so quickly.
questions.explanation: be through with「完成、結束」。

questions.question: Andy: Mr. and Mrs. White often ______ food and clothes to the people in need. Billy: Everyone says they have a kind heart.
questions.explanation: give sth to sb「給某人東西」；買、準備不接 to 結構。

questions.question: When Mr. Stone told his sons they will go camping at Blue Lake this weekend, the two boys got so ______.
questions.explanation: 人「感到興奮」用 excited。

questions.question: Jill: Wow, your dog is cute! ______ is it? Ivy: I don't really know, but at least more than ten. He came to my home ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 回答 more than ten（歲），用 How old。

questions.question: The shoe store ______ the two banks is having a sale this weekend. Let's go find some good deals.
questions.explanation: 兩家銀行「之間」用 between。

questions.question: The bad guy ______ by the police yet. Everyone here is scared and worried.
questions.explanation: yet 表現在完成式；壞人是「被」抓，故用被動 hasn't been caught。

questions.question: Alice: ______ do you exercise each time? Ben: Only half an hour, but I always exercise three times a day.
questions.explanation: 回答 half an hour（時間長度），用 How long。

questions.question: Ben: How many people ______ over for tonight's dinner, Amy? Amy: Twelve. I told you last night, honey. We need to prepare enough food.
questions.explanation: tonight 為近未來、且已安排好，用現在進行式表未來。

questions.question: Police officer: Did you see what happened? Ivan: Only a little. I ______ on my cellphone at that time.
questions.explanation: at that time 表過去某時點正在進行，用過去進行式。

questions.question: Jackson felt hungry and hurried home. His mom didn't hear him ______ in because she was busy cooking.
questions.explanation: 感官動詞 hear + sb + 原形動詞。

questions.question: I am worried about Tina. She went into the bathroom two hours ago and ______ out now. Is she all right?
questions.explanation: 兩小時前進去到現在還沒出來，用現在完成式否定。
questions.note: 語意上更自然的講法是 hasn't come out，但選項中以 (A) 最合理

questions.question: In my dream, I saw a woman without legs and eyes flying in the dark. I feel so scared. I think she ______ a ghost.
questions.explanation: 表推測「可能是」用 might be。

questions.question: Clerk: This dress comes in two sizes. Which one would you like? Tina: The ______ one, of course. I'm not that thin, you know.
questions.explanation: 兩個尺寸比較用比較級；不瘦所以選「較大」的。

questions.question: After walking ______ First Street for over twenty minutes, we finally got to the new department store.
questions.explanation: 「沿著」街道走用 along。

questions.question: The teenagers ______ ten years ago are coming to visit her this weekend. She is so excited.
questions.explanation: 省略關代 whom，過去式 took care of 與 ten years ago 對應。

questions.question: No worries. If this is the type of skirt you like, we have ______ more of them here for you to choose from.
questions.explanation: skirt 為可數複數，「還有幾件」用 a few。

questions.question: Ken was feeding the cats ______ his brother was fixing the bike in the yard.
questions.explanation: 兩動作「同時進行」用 while。

questions.question: Mrs. Wang has taught English in the junior high school since she moved here, and ______.
questions.explanation: 前句為現在完成式 has taught，附和句也用 has，且為肯定 so + 助動詞 + 主詞。

questions.question: In the box are plates and bowls. Please take good care. It ______ carried carefully.
questions.explanation: 「必須」被小心搬運；must + be + p.p. 為情態助動詞被動。

questions.question: Mrs. Cooper looked out of the window and noticed a boy walk by her yard ______ some flowers.
questions.explanation: notice + sb + 原形動詞；walk 與 pick 兩動作並列。

questions.question: Larry knows a lot about the castles in Prince Town because he ______ in the old town since he was three years old.
questions.explanation: since + 過去時間，主句用現在完成式。

questions.question: Your room is too small. I don't think ______ will be enough space for a bed and a desk. You can only choose one of them.
questions.explanation: 「會有足夠空間」用 there + be 句型。

questions.question: ______ does the movie last? My dad asked me to get home before nine p.m. I don't want to be late.
questions.explanation: 問電影「持續多久」，用 How long。
